title: The build–measure–learn loop
caption: A lean start-up builds the simplest thing that tests an assumption, measures what customers do and learns whether to continue or pivot. The meal-kit founder's 20 kits were the build; few repeat orders were the measurement.
alt: A cycle of three boxes: build a minimum viable product, measure customer behaviour, learn whether to continue, leading back to build.
description: Build a minimum viable product, the simplest version that tests a key assumption.
Learn whether to continue or pivot, then build the next test.
